summary: Frontend testing of DataRefreshProvider polling mechanism and price disclaimer banner. All features working correctly. Polling does NOT show toasts on every 30-second poll - only when new notifications exist. Manual refresh button shows 'Gegevens bijgewerkt' toast. Price disclaimer banner is visible, dismissible, and persists in sessionStorage.

Price disclaimer banner 'Belangrijk over onze prijzen' is visible on dealer dashboard
Price disclaimer banner X button dismisses the banner successfully
Price disclaimer banner stays hidden after dismiss (sessionStorage persistence)
Price disclaimer banner reappears after clearing sessionStorage and reloading
Manual refresh button 'Vernieuwen' is visible and clickable
Manual refresh button shows 'Gegevens bijgewerkt' toast on click
DataRefreshProvider polling (30 seconds) does NOT show toasts on every poll
No excessive toasts during 35-second observation period (toast count remained at 1)
isFirstCheck ref prevents toast on initial page load
lastCountRef properly tracks notification count to prevent false positives
critical_code_review_comments: DataRefreshProvider.js correctly implements isFirstCheck ref (line 26) to skip toast on initial load
lastCountRef (line 28) properly tracks notification count to prevent stale closure issues
Toast only fires when newCount > lastCount (line 63), preventing false positives
DealerDashboard.js correctly manages showPriceDisclaimer state with sessionStorage (lines 47-55)
Manual refresh correctly calls fetchMotorcycles(true) to show toast (line 92)
No duplicate 30-second interval in DealerDashboard.js - auto-refresh managed by DataRefreshProvider
